instructions:
MobileBuildMCP provides comprehensive tooling for Apple platform development (iOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS, visionOS).

Prefer MobileBuildMCP tools over shell commands for Apple platform tasks when available.

Capabilities:
- Session defaults: Configure project, scheme, simulator, and device defaults to avoid repetitive parameters
- Project discovery: Find Xcode projects/workspaces, list schemes, inspect build settings
- Simulator workflows: Build, run, test, install, and launch apps on iOS simulators; manage simulator state (boot, erase, location, appearance)
- Device workflows: Build, test, install, and launch apps on physical devices with code signing
- macOS workflows: Build, run, and test macOS applications
- Log capture: Stream and capture logs from simulators and devices
- LLDB debugging: Attach debugger, set breakpoints, inspect stack traces and variables, execute LLDB commands
- UI automation: Capture screenshots, inspect runtime UI snapshots, perform taps/swipes/gestures, type text, press hardware buttons, and batch multiple same-screen elementRef taps
- SwiftPM: Build, run, test, and manage Swift Package Manager projects
- Project scaffolding: Generate new iOS/macOS project templates

Only simulator workflow tools are enabled by default. If capabilities like device, macOS, debugging, or UI automation are not available, the user must configure MobileBuildMCP to enable them. See https://github.com/getsentry/xcodebuildmcp.com/blob/main/app/docs/_content/configuration.mdx for workflow configuration.

Simulator run flow:
- Before your first build, run, or test call in a session, you MUST call session_show_defaults to verify the active project/workspace, scheme, and simulator. Do not assume defaults are configured. Only skip this if you have already called session_show_defaults earlier in the current session.
- If session_show_defaults confirms project/workspace + scheme + simulator are set, call build_run_sim immediately (often with empty arguments).
- Use discover_projs only when session_show_defaults shows project/workspace is missing or wrong.
- Never call discover_projs speculatively or in parallel with session_show_defaults.
- Do not call boot_sim or open_sim as prerequisites for build_run_sim; build_run_sim boots and opens the simulator frontend as needed.

tools.name: session_show_defaults
tools.description: Show current active defaults. Required before your first build/run/test call in a session — do not assume defaults are configured.

tools.name: session_use_defaults_profile
tools.description: Switch the active session defaults profile.

profile.description: Activate a named session defaults profile (example: ios or watch).

global.description: Activate the global unnamed defaults profile.

tools.name: session_set_defaults
tools.description: Set session defaults for the active profile, or for a specified profile and make it active.

configuration.description: Build configuration for Xcode and SwiftPM tools (e.g. 'Debug' or 'Release').

simulatorName.description: Canonical, machine-portable simulator selector (safe to share via SCM); the background refresh re-resolves it to this machine’s UDID.

simulatorId.description: Machine-local simulator UDID, materialized from simulatorName when one is set; UDIDs are not portable across machines.

simulatorPlatform.description: Cached platform derived from the selected simulator’s runtime; must be cleared/recomputed whenever the simulator selector changes.

derivedDataPath.description: Default DerivedData path for Xcode build/test/clean tools.

preferXcodebuild.description: Prefer xcodebuild over incremental builds for Xcode build/test/clean tools.

platform.description: Default device platform for device tools (e.g. iOS, watchOS).

bundleId.description: Default bundle ID for launch/stop/log tools when working on a single app.

env.description: Default environment variables to pass to launched apps as key-value entries

extraArgs.description: Default extra xcodebuild arguments for tools that accept extraArgs.

profile.description: Set defaults for this named profile and make it active for the current session.

createIfNotExists.description: Create the named profile if it does not exist. Defaults to false.

tools.name: session_clear_defaults
tools.description: Clear session defaults for the active profile or a specified profile.

profile.description: Clear defaults for this named profile instead of the active profile.

all.description: Clear all defaults across global and named profiles. Cannot be combined with keys/profile.

tools.name: list_sims
tools.description: List iOS simulators.

tools.name: boot_sim
tools.description: Boot iOS simulator for manual/non-build flows. Not required before simulator build-and-run (build_run_sim).

tools.name: open_sim
tools.description: Open the simulator frontend for visibility and manual workflows. Not required before simulator build-and-run (build_run_sim).

tools.name: build_sim
tools.description: Build for iOS sim (compile-only, no launch).

buildForTesting.description: Build reusable test products without running tests (default: false)

testProductsPath.description: Output path for the .xctestproducts bundle when buildForTesting is true

tools.name: build_run_sim
tools.description: Build, install, and launch on iOS Simulator, booting it when needed. Runtime logs are captured automatically and the log file path is included in the response. Preferred single-step run tool when defaults are set.

extraArgs.description: Additional xcodebuild/build-settings arguments (not app launch arguments)

launchArgs.description: Arguments passed to the launched app process on simulator runtime

tools.name: test_sim
tools.description: Test on iOS sim.

testProductsPath.description: Path to a prepared .xctestproducts package. Cannot be combined with source inputs

xctestrunPath.description: Path to a prepared .xctestrun file. Cannot be combined with source inputs

testRunnerEnv.description: Environment variables to pass to the test runner (TEST_RUNNER_ prefix added automatically)

progress.description: Show detailed test progress output (MCP defaults to true, CLI defaults to false)

tools.name: get_sim_app_path
tools.description: Get sim built app path.

tools.name: install_app_sim
tools.description: Install app on sim.

appPath.description: Path to the .app bundle to install

tools.name: launch_app_sim
tools.description: Launch app on simulator. Runtime logs are captured automatically and the log file path is included in the response.

launchArgs.description: Arguments passed to the launched app process on simulator runtime

env.description: Environment variables to pass to the launched app as key-value entries (SIMCTL_CHILD_ prefix added automatically)

tools.name: stop_app_sim
tools.description: Stop sim app.

tools.name: record_sim_video
tools.description: Record sim video.

evidence.description: Non-actionable semantic evidence rows in role|label|value|identifier format. These rows intentionally omit element refs.

tools.name: clean
tools.description: Clean build products.

tools.name: discover_projs
tools.description: Scans a directory (defaults to workspace root) to find Xcode project (.xcodeproj) and workspace (.xcworkspace) files. Use when project/workspace path is unknown.

tools.name: list_schemes
tools.description: List Xcode schemes.

tools.name: show_build_settings
tools.description: Show build settings.

tools.name: get_app_bundle_id
tools.description: Extract bundle id from .app.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture screenshot.

returnFormat.description: Return image path or base64 data (path|base64)

evidence.description: Non-actionable semantic evidence rows in role|label|value|identifier format. These rows intentionally omit element refs.

tools.name: snapshot_ui
tools.description: Capture a semantic rs/1 runtime UI snapshot with elementRef targets. Observe once, use tap for one target or batch for multiple same-screen targets, and refresh after navigation, scrolling, sheet changes, or obvious layout changes.

sinceScreenHash.description: Return an unchanged response when the current screen hash matches this value

evidence.description: Non-actionable semantic evidence rows in role|label|value|identifier format. These rows intentionally omit element refs.

tools.name: get_coverage_report
tools.description: Show per-target code coverage from an xcresult bundle.

target.description: Filter results to a specific target name

showFiles.description: When true, include per-file coverage breakdown under each target

tools.name: get_file_coverage
tools.description: Show function-level coverage and uncovered line ranges for a specific file.

file.description: Source file name or path to inspect

showLines.description: When true, include uncovered line ranges from the archive

tools.name: wait_for_ui
tools.description: Poll rs/1 runtime UI snapshots until a selector-based UI predicate, selector-free textContains/gone text predicate, or selector-free settled predicate is satisfied, then record the latest snapshot. Prefer this after navigation or layout changes. Select with elementRef, identifier, label, role, or value when a selector is needed.

evidence.description: Non-actionable semantic evidence rows in role|label|value|identifier format. These rows intentionally omit element refs.

tools.name: batch
tools.description: UI automation batch for multiple same-screen elementRef taps, especially visible settings switches that can be toggled without intermediate assertions. The input key is steps, never commands, and each step is an object such as {"action":"tap","elementRef":"e1"}; do not pass raw command strings. Use refs from the latest snapshot_ui or wait_for_ui output, for example {"steps":[{"action":"tap","elementRef":"e1"},{"action":"tap","elementRef":"e2"}]}. Omit preDelay/postDelay for switch elementRefs; switches execute as touch down/up steps and reject delays.

elementRef.description: Runtime elementRef from the latest snapshot_ui or wait_for_ui output

preDelay.description: Seconds before this step. Omit for switch elementRefs.

postDelay.description: Seconds after this step. Omit for switch elementRefs.

steps.description: Required array of step objects, for example [{"action":"tap","elementRef":"e1"}]. Do not use commands or raw command strings.

evidence.description: Non-actionable semantic evidence rows in role|label|value|identifier format. These rows intentionally omit element refs.

tools.name: tap
tools.description: Tap one elementRef from the latest snapshot_ui or wait_for_ui output. The elementRef must list the tap action in the snapshot targets; do not use refs from text-only rows. For multiple same-screen taps or visible switch toggles with no intermediate assertion, use batch instead of repeated tap calls. Other same-screen refs may remain usable after success; refresh after navigation, scrolling, sheet changes, or obvious layout changes.

evidence.description: Non-actionable semantic evidence rows in role|label|value|identifier format. These rows intentionally omit element refs.

tools.name: touch
tools.description: Send touch down/up events to a UI element by elementRef from a current rs/1 runtime snapshot.

evidence.description: Non-actionable semantic evidence rows in role|label|value|identifier format. These rows intentionally omit element refs.

tools.name: long_press
tools.description: Long press a UI element by elementRef from a current rs/1 runtime snapshot.

evidence.description: Non-actionable semantic evidence rows in role|label|value|identifier format. These rows intentionally omit element refs.

tools.name: swipe
tools.description: Swipe within a scrollable UI element using withinElementRef from a current rs/1 runtime snapshot. withinElementRef is required; do not use elementRef. Optional distance is a normalized stroke fraction greater than 0 and up to 1. Example input: {"withinElementRef":"e7","direction":"up","distance":0.7}.

distance.description: Normalized stroke fraction greater than 0 and up to 1

evidence.description: Non-actionable semantic evidence rows in role|label|value|identifier format. These rows intentionally omit element refs.

tools.name: drag
tools.description: Drag from a visible runtime elementRef in a direction, then return a refreshed runtime UI snapshot. Use this for exposed sheet grabbers or real scroll/list content refs when nextSteps suggests dragging; do not use raw screen coordinates.

elementRef.description: Runtime elementRef from the latest snapshot_ui or wait_for_ui output

direction.description: Drag direction: up, down, left, or right

distance.description: Normalized drag distance greater than 0 and up to 1 within the resolved element or viewport

evidence.description: Non-actionable semantic evidence rows in role|label|value|identifier format. These rows intentionally omit element refs.

tools.name: gesture
tools.description: Simulator gesture preset.

screenWidth.description: Screen width in pixels. Used for gesture calculations. Auto-detected if not provided.

screenHeight.description: Screen height in pixels. Used for gesture calculations. Auto-detected if not provided.

duration.description: Duration of the gesture in seconds.

preDelay.description: Delay before starting the gesture in seconds.

postDelay.description: Delay after completing the gesture in seconds.

evidence.description: Non-actionable semantic evidence rows in role|label|value|identifier format. These rows intentionally omit element refs.

tools.name: button
tools.description: Press simulator hardware button.

evidence.description: Non-actionable semantic evidence rows in role|label|value|identifier format. These rows intentionally omit element refs.

tools.name: key_press
tools.description: Press one hardware key using an AXe HID key code. Prefer type_text for text entry. Common values include 40 Return/Enter, 42 Backspace, 43 Tab, and 44 Space.

keyCode.description: HID keycode. Common values: 40 Return/Enter, 42 Backspace, 43 Tab, 44 Space.

evidence.description: Non-actionable semantic evidence rows in role|label|value|identifier format. These rows intentionally omit element refs.

tools.name: key_sequence
tools.description: Press hardware keys using AXe HID key codes. Prefer type_text for text entry. Common values include 40 Return/Enter, 42 Backspace, 43 Tab, and 44 Space.

keyCodes.description: HID keycodes. Common values: 40 Return/Enter, 42 Backspace, 43 Tab, 44 Space.

evidence.description: Non-actionable semantic evidence rows in role|label|value|identifier format. These rows intentionally omit element refs.

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Type text into a UI element by elementRef from a current rs/1 runtime snapshot, optionally replacing existing field contents. elementRef is required; do not call with only text. Example input: {"elementRef":"e8","text":"London","replaceExisting":true}.

elementRef.description: Required runtime text-field elementRef from the latest snapshot_ui or wait_for_ui output

replaceExisting.description: Select and replace existing field contents before typing

evidence.description: Non-actionable semantic evidence rows in role|label|value|identifier format. These rows intentionally omit element refs.
